title: Strive Buys $335 Million in Bitcoin After Investors Pour In $369 Million
summary: The Nasdaq-listed bitcoin holder bought as warrant holders exercised, bringing in $369 million, and it now plans a $630 million sale of 15% preferred stock.

title: XRP Ledger Repairs Its Lending Protocol Before It Goes Live

summary: JPMorgan is rolling out JPM Coin on Ethereum for institutional clients, a token backed by dollars in its accounts that settles in seconds, any day of the week.

summary: Bitcoin keeps limping back to the same floor while $108 oil and 5% yields weigh on risk assets. The chart shows a coiled spring, not a trend.

summary: The purchase lifts Bitmine’s stash to 6.04 million ETH—4.9% of supply and 99% of the way to its “Alchemy of 5%” goal—as chairman Tom Lee framed a market-wide selloff as an attractive entry point.

summary: The original “Black Monday” occurred 39 years ago today. Is history about to repeat itself?

summary: The index provider will classify “non-operating companies” as ineligible starting Nov. 30, targeting firms whose balance sheets are dominated by a single asset.

title: CFTC Wants to Drop Gemini’s $5M Settlement. A Judge Just Said No
